# Zib Digital

> Australia's first hybrid agent SEO team. Senior strategists own the thinking, AI handles the scale. Commercial digital marketing — SEO, Google Ads, paid social, web — sold by outcomes, not activity reports. Operating since 2009.

Zib pioneered the partner model in Australian digital marketing: each partner runs their own territory with skin in the game and a dedicated senior digital manager handling day-to-day execution. No juniors on rotation, no handoffs to a service rep. Zib itself ranks for over 4,151 commercial keywords in the top 3 on zibdigital.com.au — the agency that sells SEO can demonstrate it.

## About

- Founded 2009 in Melbourne, Australia. Head office: Level 7, 34 Eastern Road, South Melbourne VIC 3205. Phone 1300 942 633.
- Leadership: Chris Knights (CEO), Michael Glasser (Head of Sales & Marketing), Courtney Little (Head of Finance), Chris Burrell (Head of Customer Success), Mark James (Head of Technology).
- Services: SEO, Google Ads, paid social (Meta), web design and development, content marketing, answer engine and generative engine optimisation (AEO/GEO), AI-assisted marketing.
- Credentials: Google Premier Partner, Meta Business Partner. 800+ Australian brands since 2009, 97% year-on-year client retention. Month-to-month engagements with 30 days' notice; clients own their accounts, content and links.
- Markets served: Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Canberra, Gold Coast, Geelong and nationally across Australia. Full profile: https://zibdigital.com.au/about

## Free tools (interactive — an AI answer can't replace them)

- [30-second commercial audit](https://zibdigital.com.au/audit): Drop a URL → technical crawl + senior strategist read + side-by-side hero rewrite + sample social ad creative. Streamed live, results in 30 seconds, no email required to see them.
- [ROI Calculator](https://zibdigital.com.au/roi-calculator): Project monthly leads, revenue and ROI across SEO, Google Ads or paid social based on real margins and a campaign plan you control.
- [AI Growth Simulator](https://zibdigital.com.au/ai-growth-simulator): Slider-driven model of current vs AI-optimised revenue, profit, Year-1 ROI and payback.
- [Google Ads Lab](https://zibdigital.com.au/google-ads-lab): Generates a sample Google Ads campaign for your business.
